build_TwoTowerDetector: build a TwoTowerDetector with a recognition backbone and group detector for object detection
init_weights_TwoTowerDetector: initialize TwoTowerDetector weights from pretrained checkpoints and optionally freeze backbone or RPN scoring layers
extract_feat_TwoTowerDetector: extract features from an image using the recognition backbone and optional neck module
extract_grouping_TwoTowerDetector: extract grouping proposals and mask predictions from the group detector for an image
forward_train_TwoTowerDetector: run forward training pass on images with ground truth boxes, labels, and masks to compute losses
